_about: Phase 7. Wall side FROZEN at the Phase 6 permissive gate and 0.12 m. The variable is the object side: nearest visible surface (baseline) vs catalogue-grounded physical extent. No labels consulted anywhere; dimensions come from the asset registry, the built-in catalogue, or a family default, in that order, each with its own confidence.

notes: family default for 'storage'; no registry or built-in entry

comparison.note: catalogue_wallnormal uses the PRE-DECLARED orientation rule and is the primary result; catalogue_depthfirst is a POST-HOC physical prior and must be confirmed on new data before it is preferred.

oracle_agreement.note: Agreement between catalogue depth and the Phase 5 MANUAL estimate on its 26 cases. The manual estimate is not ground truth; this measures whether two independent sources of the same quantity agree.

latency.note: extent computation is CPU-only numpy; no model, no VRAM

threshold_sweep_diagnostic.note: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY; the gate used 0.12 m.

confidence_abstention_diagnostic.note: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, post hoc. Cases whose decision_confidence is below the floor are treated as UNKNOWN. The gate result used no confidence floor.
